tests.name: FN_big_winner_signature_coherence_3d
tests.comparison: Compute standardized 3-D Euclidean distance between the two false_negative_big_winner entities (entity_535a1beed7, entity_de1c657364) versus the median pairwise distance among the 11 selected_winner entities on the same three features. Standardization uses the selected_winner median and MAD.
tests.success_criterion: FN-vs-FN standardized distance is at most 0.75× the median selected_winner-vs-selected_winner distance, indicating a tighter coherent signature than the winners themselves.
tests.failure_criterion: FN-vs-FN distance exceeds the 75th percentile of winner-vs-winner pairwise distances — the two FNs disagree on key claimed features by more than is typical within the winner class, falsifying 'coherent signature'.

tests.name: composite_ruin_contamination_count
tests.comparison: Apply the joint constraint mom_20<0.06 AND vol_ratio_5_20<1.20 AND 0.45<=up_day_ratio_20<=0.70 to the 8 false_positive_ruin entities and to the false_negative_big_winner entities; report capture rate per group.
tests.success_criterion: Zero of 8 false_positive_ruin entities satisfy the joint constraint while both false_negative_big_winner entities satisfy it — composite perfectly discriminates.
tests.failure_criterion: Two or more false_positive_ruin entities satisfy the joint constraint — composite cannot distinguish latent winners from latent ruins at the signal level, regardless of how it performs on winners.

tests.name: pullback_structure_separation_non_null_only
tests.comparison: Restrict to entities with non-null pullback fields: false_negative entities with non-null pullback (entity_df5478102d, entity_bfb308b24a, entity_de1c657364; n=3) versus selected_winner entities with non-null pullback (entity_8f0df3d38e, entity_8ad5cd4795, entity_2c58cebc59, entity_3adc078f01, entity_ccc90a671f, entity_55c2da490e; n=6). Compute medians per group.
tests.success_criterion: FN median pullback_duration_weeks exceeds winner median by at least 2 weeks AND FN median base_mbox_count >= winner median AND |FN median base_depth_pct| < |winner median base_depth_pct| — i.e. longer, denser, shallower bases.
tests.failure_criterion: Either the duration gap is <2 weeks OR the FN median base_mbox_count is below the winner median OR |FN base_depth_pct| is not smaller than |winner base_depth_pct|. A failure on any leg falsifies the 'extended shallow base' substrate claim as a necessary feature.

tests.name: entry_footprint_separation_fn_vs_ruin
tests.comparison: Compare false_negative_big_winner entities (n=2) versus false_positive_ruin entities (n=8) on the three entry-context features. Predicted by the mechanism: FNs should have a quieter entry footprint (lower volume ratio, close nearer day midpoint, tighter breakout range).
tests.success_criterion: FN median ibd_entry_volume_ratio is at least 0.30 below ruin median AND FN median ibd_entry_close_position is at least 0.05 below ruin median — entry footprint alone separates latent winners from latent ruins.
tests.failure_criterion: FN median ibd_entry_volume_ratio is within 0.10 of ruin median, OR FN median ibd_entry_close_position exceeds ruin median — ruins share the FN entry profile, so the entry-footprint angle cannot substitute for the composite.

tests.name: within_snapshot_winner_vs_fn_incoherence
tests.comparison: Within snap_71486ed83c, compute standardized 3-D distance between the selected_winner entity_2c58cebc59 (mom_20=0.320, vol_ratio_5_20=1.619, px_vs_ma50=0.170) and each of the two false_negative_big_winner entities in the same snapshot. Then compute the distance between the two FNs themselves. Compare ratios.
tests.success_criterion: Distance from selected_winner to either FN is at least 1.5× the FN-to-FN distance — within-snapshot winners and FNs are more different from each other than FNs are from each other, supporting the skeptic's claim that the snapshot does not host a homogeneous regime.
tests.failure_criterion: Selected_winner-to-FN distance is within 1.2× of FN-to-FN distance — the picked winner and the missed winners in the same snapshot share a recognizable profile, consistent with a shared regime that the B0 filter only partially captured.

leakage_checks: outcome_label and w4_return_bucket appear only as grouping/target variables; they must never enter the feature list of any test.

is_b0_pick is a downstream decision output, not a PIT input feature; it must not be used as a feature in any test or as a grouping variable that conditions the test population beyond the pre-specified entity selection.
snapshot_anon may be used only as a grouping key for population restriction; it must not be treated as a feature and no snapshot-identifying string may be encoded numerically as a feature.
entity_anon is identity and must not be used as a feature; entity selection within groups must be pre-specified by outcome_label membership, not by ad-hoc inspection.
Pullback fields with null values must remain null in every aggregation; no imputation to zero, no exclusion of null entities without explicit pre-specification of the non-null subset.

All momentum features (mom_20, mom_60, ma10_slope_5, ma20_slope_5, ma50_slope_10) and base features (base_mbox_count, base_duration_weeks, base_depth_pct) must be verified to be computed from data dated at or before snapshot_anon; any feature that references post-snapshot returns invalidates the test.
ibd_entry_* features reference entry-day data only and must not incorporate post-entry price action; if any entry feature is undefined for a given entity it must be flagged before inclusion.
Standardization (median, MAD) for any distance-based test must be computed on the comparison group specified in the test, not on a pooled sample that includes the units being measured.
